Diyab's own memoir is ranked separately from the Arabian Nights; his role in the transmission of some Nights stories does not make the books identical.

works.description: Rank 100 in the owner-supplied regional synthesis. Form: Graphic novel trilogy / omnibus. A highly inventive meeting of visual storytelling and social fantasy; included as a provisional modern addition rather than a claim of established century-long durability. The Arabic graphic trilogy is treated as one work, as in the English omnibus. Its long-term standing is necessarily less tested than that of older selections.
